items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Aims to Double Colossus 2’s Nvidia Chips by Year-End
items.summary_cn: 据报道,Musk计划年底前将xAI Colossus 2的Nvidia芯片数量翻倍,继续大手笔采购H100/B200等,直接利好NVDA链。

items.summary_cn: 据报道,Musk旗下SpaceX大举部署/调整Nvidia芯片,间接利好其AI算力叙事,SpaceX相关持仓情绪受益。

items.text: 以太坊的價值和傑文斯悖論

items.text: Elon Musk Says SpaceX’s AI Model May Surpass Anthropic And OpenAI’s In 6 Months
items.summary_cn: 据报道,Musk称SpaceX自有AI模型有望在6个月内超越Anthropic和OpenAI,为其AI战略背书。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Is US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth A Bitcoiner? This Is What His Accounts Say
items.summary_cn: 据报道,美国国防部长Hegseth被曝疑似比特币持有人,政界加密派影响力扩张,情绪利好CRCL等加密相关持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Trump bought and sold shares in Musk's SpaceX in July, financial disclosure shows
items.summary_cn: 据报道,Trump财务披露显示其个人在7月曾买卖SpaceX相关份额,SpaceX未上市,仅作情绪信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: RT: https://truthsocial.com/users/realDonaldTrump/statuses/117326044871082645This is a survey of people in business — the S&P Flash Survey — of purchasing, manufacturing and hiring. Guess what? The report shows impressive Growth.   Composite Index — Services + Manufacturing, 62 month high!   Manufacturing — 53 month high!   Services — 52 month high!   This is the “HOTTEST” Economy in the World — and the Media is working overtime for the Democrats to convince Voters that the opposite is true.     For working people, a “HOT” Economy is good because it gives them more wage leverage, and more flex
items.summary_cn: Trump转推S&P Flash Survey,称美国综合PMI创62个月新高、制造业53个月新高、服务业52个月新高,自称'全球最热经济',为中期选举造势,宏观顺风利好风险资产。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Trump-Xi state dinner guest list included Mary Barra, Elon Musk
items.summary_cn: 据报道,Trump-Xi国宴嘉宾名单含Mary Barra(GM)和Elon Musk,中美政商关系信号,板块情绪中性。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: China’s Xi shares a rare laugh on White House tour at Trump’s Biden mockery
items.summary_cn: 据报道,习近平在白宫参观时对Trump模仿Biden罕见发笑,中美关系软化信号,间接利好港股科技板块情绪。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry Drops Stark Message For AI Stock Investors
items.summary_cn: 据报道,Michael Burry对AI股票投资者发出尖锐警告,看空AI板块情绪;未点名具体标的。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Should Investors Worry About Michael Burry's Big AI Stock Shorts
items.summary_cn: 据报道,媒体讨论Burry大手笔做空AI股的潜在风险,空头叙事继续发酵,板块情绪偏负面。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Big Short's Burry Bets on Copper, Skips AI Hype
items.summary_cn: 据报道,Burry重仓铜、回避AI炒作,看多铜价,与中国需求/绿色转型主题相关。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Very productive meeting with President Xi for both the U.S.A. and China. Tremendous things will be happening. Like almost everyone else, he seemed to like calling the poorly and inaccurately named Artificial Intelligence to a far more accurate and important name, SUPER INTELLIGENCE. That would be “SUPER!” Everyone last night agreed, also. President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump会面习近平,称双方同意将'人工智能'改称'超级智能(SI)',表态中美AI领域合作有空间,宏观利好AI板块情绪。

items.author: Trump
items.text: RT @realDonaldTrumpA big day with President Xi of China. Super Intelligence (SI) will be a big topic of discussion, but I want to leave it exactly where it is. That is China’s position also. Our guardrail is the DOJ! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump确认'超级智能'为与习近平会谈大议题,并指DOJ为对华AI合作的'护栏',信号中美AI/科技摩擦或阶段性缓和。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Memphis residents file noise complaint against Elon Musk’s xAI
items.summary_cn: 据报道,孟菲斯居民就xAI数据中心噪声提起投诉,xAI未上市无直接交易代码,但舆论压力或影响Musk系AI叙事。
